description.narrative: The aim of this project is to develop a data warehouse and improved business intelligence in order to improve company performance, but also to improve BAV’s client service and product offerings. As part of its regular business process, CAA-Indonesia collects a wealth of information about clients as well as transaction-level details for each process. To obtain a deeper understanding of patterns and trends in business performance and relate them to client segments, geographical areas and other associated data points, BAV considers it key to create a unified data warehouse along with a reporting platform.
